This role is an opportunity to help shape the next chapter of ANINE BING. As a key contributor within our Paris HQ team, the RTW Intern Designer supports the PAP Studio in day-to-day coordination and collection development, bringing precision and creative energy to their work — supporting our global growth while staying grounded in the brand's DNA: refined, fast-moving, and always evolving. We're looking for someone who thrives in a creative yet performance-driven environment. The ideal candidate combines a sharp eye for detail with a clear sense of the big picture, is comfortable moving between technical execution and creative research, and is energized by building something special—together. This is an internship based at our Paris HQ , in-person, for a minimum duration of 6 months . The role reports to the Head of Design , with a dotted line to the Senior Designer . Responsibilities Include: Studio coordination & collection support: produce technical drawings on Illustrator, update and maintain technical files (tech packs), and keep collection boards, moodboards, and working boards current throughout the season. Design execution: color and finish sketches, build collection boards, produce presentation mock-ups and supports, and develop digital color ranges. Research: conduct iconographic research on styles, finishes, materials and details, and develop visual references to support collection direction. File management: organize and maintain collection files and digital archives. Fittings & prototype follow-up: assist at proto fittings, style-outs and shopping sessions; take photos and update technical drawings and annotations following each fitting. Prototype tracking: archive and organize fitting photos and information, and track modifications made to styles throughout development; help prepare fittings (silhouettes, looks, accessories, visual supports). General studio support: prepare documents and boards for collection presentations and meetings, maintain creative and trend watch, and support the studio's day-to-day organization as needed. Requirements: Final-year student at a fashion design school, available for a minimum 6-month internship . Advanced proficiency in Photoshop and Illustrator is mandatory , including technical drawing execution. Strong attention to detail and rigor in following technical and creative briefs. Fluent English required; French professional proficiency is a plus given the Paris-based team. Organized, proactive, and comfortable working across parallel priorities in a creative, performance-driven environment. Benefits & Perks At ANINE BING Paris, we combine creative ambition with a people-first culture, exclusive discounts on our collections, and private sales access — so you can live the brand as much as you build it. Style Perks: enjoy a generous employee discount — so you can live the brand, not just represent it. Working at ANINE BING ANINE BING seeks to empower its employees by providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Diversity and inclusion is critical to our success as a global brand, and we seek to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. More about ANINE BING ANINE BING is a Los Angeles-based fashion house founded in 2012 that blends elements of Scandinavian simplicity with American energy to offer modern wardrobe essentials for women seeking a timeless yet rebellious approach to everyday style. Since its launch, ANINE BING has evolved into a global brand, available in over 90 countries with a growing network of brick-and-mortar retail stores in key cities worldwide. Powered by a global team of over 250 employees, ANINE BING is headquartered in Los Angeles and Paris, with additional offices in New York and Shanghai. About Our Paris HQ Located just off the Champs-Élysées, our Paris headquarters at 1 Rue François 1er is a cornerstone of our international growth. As the home of our Product teams and other key functions, this space reflects our commitment to creativity, collaboration, and global perspective. As we continue to grow across Europe, our Paris office plays a central role in shaping the future of our brand.
